2025-04-03.detail: 4/2 川普宣布對所有進口課 10% 基準關稅、對中國等數十國加徵更高對等關稅；4/3 S&P500 重挫 4.8%、Nasdaq 約 -6%，為 2020 年疫情以來最慘單日。高 beta 成長股（Apple/Nvidia 等）跌幅更深。
2025-04-03.detail_en: On 4/2 Trump announced a 10% baseline tariff on all imports plus steeper reciprocal tariffs on dozens of countries including China; on 4/3 the S&P 500 fell 4.8% and the Nasdaq about -6%, the worst single day since the 2020 pandemic. High-beta growth names (Apple/Nvidia, etc.) fell even harder.

2025-04-04.event: 關稅暴跌第二日 · 中國反制
2025-04-04.detail: 中國宣布對美對等反制關稅，市場恐慌延續；S&P500 再跌約 6%，兩日累計近 -11%，Nasdaq 正式進入熊市。
2025-04-04.detail_en: China announced reciprocal counter-tariffs on the US and the panic continued; the S&P 500 fell another ~6%, down nearly -11% over two days, and the Nasdaq officially entered a bear market.

2025-01-27.detail: 中國新創 DeepSeek 推出低成本 R1 模型，市場質疑 AI 高資本支出與晶片需求；Nvidia 單日 -17%、市值蒸發約 5,890 億美元（史上最大），半導體與 AI 類股全面重挫。
2025-01-27.detail_en: Chinese startup DeepSeek released its low-cost R1 model, prompting doubts about AI capex and chip demand; Nvidia fell -17% in a day, wiping out about $589B of market cap (a record), and semiconductor and AI stocks sold off across the board.

2025-03-06.event: 關稅反覆 + Marvell 財測 · Nasdaq 進入修正
2025-03-06.event_en: Tariff flip-flops + Marvell guidance · Nasdaq enters correction
2025-03-06.detail: 川普對加墨中關稅反覆，Marvell 財測不如高預期暴跌約 20% 拖累晶片股；Nasdaq 跌 2.6% 正式進入修正區；Palantir 當日 -10.7%（受 CEO 減持消息影響）。
2025-03-06.detail_en: Trump kept flip-flopping on Canada/Mexico/China tariffs; Marvell's guidance missed lofty expectations and the stock crashed ~20%, dragging chip names; the Nasdaq fell 2.6% into correction territory; Palantir fell -10.7% on news of CEO share sales.

2025-03-10.event: 衰退疑慮 · 川普不排除經濟衰退
2025-03-10.event_en: Recession fears · Trump won't rule out a recession
2025-03-10.detail: 川普受訪不排除今年陷入衰退，加上關稅不確定性；Nasdaq 跌 4%（2022 年 9 月以來最差），Tesla 重挫 15%，消費性類股領跌。
2025-03-10.detail_en: In an interview Trump declined to rule out a recession this year, adding to tariff uncertainty; the Nasdaq fell 4% (worst since Sep 2022), Tesla crashed 15%, and consumer names led the decline.

2024-05-07.event: Palantir 財測不佳（個股事件）
2024-05-07.detail: 持股 Palantir Q1 營收優於預期，但全年財測低於市場共識，股價單日 -14%，拖累集中成長型投組。屬個股事件而非大盤普跌。
2024-05-07.detail_en: Holding Palantir beat on Q1 revenue but its full-year guidance came in below consensus; the stock fell -14% in a day, dragging the concentrated growth portfolio. This was a single-stock event, not a broad market selloff.

2023-08-09.event: 8 月回檔 · 殖利率走高
2023-08-09.detail: Fitch 於 8/1 調降美國主權評等後，長天期公債殖利率上行，加上中國通縮與房地產疑慮，成長股 8 月初承壓。
2023-08-09.detail_en: After Fitch downgraded the US sovereign rating on 8/1, long-dated Treasury yields rose, and with China deflation and property worries, growth stocks came under pressure in early August.

2023-08-16.event: FOMC 會議紀要偏鷹 · 殖利率再升
2023-08-16.event_en: Hawkish FOMC minutes · yields rise again
2023-08-16.detail: 7 月 FOMC 會議紀要顯示官員仍擔憂通膨、傾向維持限制性利率，10 年期殖利率走高壓抑科技成長股。
2023-08-16.detail_en: The July FOMC minutes showed officials still worried about inflation and inclined to keep rates restrictive; the 10-year yield rose, weighing on tech growth stocks.

2023-10-25.event: 大型科技財報 + 10Y 殖利率逼近 5%
2023-10-25.detail: Alphabet 雲端營收不如預期帶動科技股下挫，10 年期公債殖利率逼近 5% 之高位，成長股估值受壓。
2023-10-25.detail_en: Alphabet's cloud revenue missed expectations, dragging tech stocks lower, while the 10-year Treasury yield approached the 5% high, pressuring growth-stock valuations.

2024-01-03.event: 年初科技股回吐 · 重新定價降息
2024-01-03.event_en: Early-year tech giveback · repricing rate cuts
2024-01-03.detail: 年初市場下修對 Fed 提前降息的預期、多家券商下調蘋果等科技股評等，前一年漲多的成長股回吐。
2024-01-03.detail_en: At the start of the year the market dialed back expectations for early Fed rate cuts and several brokers downgraded tech names like Apple, so the prior year's big-gaining growth stocks gave back.

2023-10-26.event: Meta 財報賣壓 · 殖利率高檔
2023-10-26.detail: Meta 公布財報後示警廣告前景不確定、股價重挫，拖累整體大型科技與成長股；10 年期公債殖利率仍處 ~4.9% 高檔壓抑估值，延續 10 月下旬的回檔。
2023-10-26.detail_en: After reporting, Meta warned of an uncertain ad outlook and the stock plunged, dragging big-tech and growth stocks; the 10-year yield stayed high at ~4.9%, pressuring valuations and extending the late-October pullback.

2024-02-16.event: PPI 超預期 · 降息預期延後
2024-02-16.event_en: Hot PPI · rate-cut bets pushed back
2024-02-16.detail: 1 月 PPI 高於預期、加上稍早 CPI 偏熱，市場下修並延後對 Fed 降息的預期，殖利率走高；漲多的高 beta 成長股當日領跌。
2024-02-16.detail_en: January PPI came in above expectations and, with a hot CPI earlier, the market pushed back its Fed rate-cut expectations and yields rose; high-beta growth stocks that had rallied led the day's decline.
